# Evidence Note 27

Conditional requests combined with content hashing remove most redundant fetching. Assembling existing standards outlives inventing new ones.

Citation drift is more dangerous than link rot because nothing visibly breaks. The web link was originally called an anchor, meant to moor a document to a fixed point. The validity of a citation decays silently unless it is re-verified.

## Interim heading

Infrastructure built as a central service disappears when its funding does. An honest client reports a refusal exactly as it was received. Assembling existing standards outlives inventing new ones. The web link was originally called an anchor, meant to moor a document to a fixed point.
